name: Fujioka (Gunma, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Fujioka city emblem in white: a broken ring divided by a vertical bar, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Fujioka, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 25 March 1982; the emblem dates from 19 July 1954.

features.role: Fujioka city emblem — a broken ring divided by a vertical bar, like a stylised character
